pdf_page_count reads the page count of a PDF without rendering a page

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import Xberg

let pdfBytesData = try Data(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: "pdf/sample_contract.pdf"))
let pdfBytesBytes = Array(pdfBytesData)
let result = try Xberg.pdfPageCount(pdfBytes: pdfBytesBytes)
print(result)
```
